shape: 6 corpora (3 organizational, 2 investigative, 1 communication); 259 documents, 89 queries; BEIR layout (corpus.jsonl, queries.jsonl, qrels/test.tsv)
notes: Corpora only — the OIDA system itself is unreleased. Nine epistemic classes incl. DECISION/HYPOTHESIS/QUESTION; the most directly reusable public artifact for the epistemic-wedge thesis. Synthetic and small; the authors' own paper documents metric circularity — use the corpora, not their EQS metric. Attribution required (CC-BY-4.0).
